successors.name: Spanish Empire
successors.text: Tondo, which capitulated to the Spanish in 1571

ledger.x: c. 1497: the Pasig mouth becomes Maynila's. 'Manila was probably founded as a Bornean trading colony about 1500' (Scott, on the Maynila page); the Tondo page says Brunei under Bolkiah 'decided to break Tondo's monopoly'. The year is Cliopatria's (a Brunei shape on the cell in 1497-1520, Maynila from 1521); the Maynila…

c. 1520: Tondo and Maynila fight over territory. The Tondo page infobox 'Territorial conflict with Maynila during the reign of Rajah Matanda's mother: c. 1520'; the Maynila page: 'Aganduru Moriz's account: Ache's cousin, ruler of Tondo, was taking over territory belonging to Maynila'. Where the border ran is not…

c. 1521: the conflict is over by the time Lakandula and Matanda rule. Maynila infobox 'Death of Rajah Salalila and territorial conflicts with Tondo: c. before 1521'; the page gives no treaty or last battle, so 1521 is a bridge.
1570: the Spanish arrive at Manila Bay.
3 June 1571: the last resistance at Bangkusay.

wars.name: Brunei-Tondo rivalry over the China trade
wars.outcome: 'During the reign of Sultan Bolkiah in 1485 to 1521, the Sultanate of Brunei decided to break Tondo's monopoly': Maynila becomes a Bornean-linked rival port; no fighting or border is dated.

wars.name: Spanish conquest of Manila Bay
wars.outcome: Spanish forces under Goiti (1570) and Legazpi (1571) take Maynila and Tondo; Bangkusay on 3 June 1571 is the last resistance; Manila declared a Spanish city on 24 June 1571.

certainty.note: A river-mouth port polity with allies upriver: no line is given on the page; the Manila Bay shore is natural, every inland edge is approximate.
